sentences.translation: Unfortunately, my neighbor was involved in a traffic accident, and is currently in a coma.

sentences.translation: Translation is by no means easy.

sentences.translation: English is easy to learn.

sentences.translation: English is not easy for him to learn.

sentences.translation: The examples in this dictionary are easy to understand.

sentences.hanzi: 這種說明書應該寫得簡單易懂一點。
sentences.translation: Such manuals should be written in simpler language.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ hěn xūyào yìyú shǐyòng de ruǎntǐ.
sentences.translation: User-friendly software is important for my needs.

sentences.translation: Tom wants a computer small enough to easily carry.

sentences.pinyin: tā jiàntà nà xiāng yìsuì pǐn, huǐhuài le lǐmiàn de wùpǐn.
sentences.translation: He stomped on the fragile box, destroying its contents.

sentences.hanzi: 玻璃易碎。
sentences.pinyin: bōli yìsuì.
sentences.translation: Glass breaks easily.

sentences.hanzi: 這本書是用簡單英語寫成的，所以十分易讀。
sentences.translation: Written in easy English, the book is easy to read.

sentences.hanzi: 这本书很易读。

sentences.translation: This book is easy to read.

sentences.hanzi: 这些照片总是让我想起昔日时光。
sentences.pinyin: zhèxiē zhàopiàn zǒngshì ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ xīrì shíguāng.
sentences.translation: These pictures always remind me of the old days.

sentences.pinyin: jīnwǎn de yèkōng xīngguāng fēicháng míngliàng.
sentences.translation: Tonight in the night sky, the stars are shining very brightly.

sentences.translation: I count the sparkle of constellations to foretell the future of my love.

sentences.hanzi: 我數著星宿的星光來預測我愛情的未來。
sentences.translation: I count the sparkle of constellations to foretell the future of my love.

sentences.hanzi: 你什么星座啊？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ shénme xīngzuò a?
sentences.translation: What's your sign?

sentences.hanzi: 无数星星在天上闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: wúshù xīngxing zài tiānshàng shǎnshuò.
sentences.translation: Countless stars were twinkling in the sky.

sentences.hanzi: 这是本关于星星的书。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì běn guānyú xīngxing de shū.
sentences.translation: This is a book about stars.

sentences.pinyin: tiānkōng zhōng yǒushù shíyì de xīngxing.
sentences.translation: There are billions of stars in the sky.

sentences.hanzi: 你可以用望远镜看星星。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ kěyǐ yòng wàngyuǎnjìng kàn xīngxing.
sentences.translation: You can use a telescope to look at the stars.

sentences.hanzi: 那顆星星可以用裸眼看到。
sentences.pinyin: nà kē xīngxing kěyǐ yòng luǒyǎn kàndào.
sentences.translation: That star is visible to the naked eye.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ xūyào yīge xīngqī lái dǎoshíchā.
sentences.translation: I need a week to adjust to the time difference.

sentences.pinyin: xuě cóng míngtiān kāishǐ xià, yīzhí chíxù yīge xīngqī.
sentences.translation: Starting tomorrow, it's going to snow for a week.

sentences.hanzi: 大约下一星期的雨。
sentences.translation: It's been raining for around a week.

sentences.translation: I went to England for two weeks to hang out and see the sights.

sentences.translation: Mary invited me to stay a couple of weeks with her next summer.

sentences.translation: I hate Mondays.

sentences.translation: Tomorrow is Monday, isn't it?

sentences.pinyin: tāngmǔ xīngqīyī zuòfàn.
sentences.translation: Tom cooked dinner on Monday.

sentences.pinyin: tāngmǔ yīnggāi děngdào xīngqīyī.
sentences.translation: Tom should wait until Monday.

sentences.hanzi: 星期一適合做那件事。
sentences.pinyin: xīngqīyī shìhé zuò nà jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: Monday is a good day to do that.

sentences.pinyin: xīngqīsān xiàwǔ wǒ zài.
sentences.translation: I will be here Wednesday afternoon.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ bùzhī dào jīntiān shì xīngqī'èr háishi xīngqīsān.
sentences.translation: I don't know if today is Tuesday or Wednesday.

sentences.translation: The movie theater has discounts every Monday and Wednesday.

sentences.hanzi: 星期三在嗎？
sentences.translation: Will you be here on Wednesday?

sentences.pinyin: jīntiān shì xīngqīsān.
sentences.translation: Today is Wednesday.

sentences.translation: Today is Tuesday.

sentences.pinyin: xīngqī'èr shì shìjiè jiànkāng rì.

sentences.pinyin: shùxué kè ānpái zài xīngqī'èr.
sentences.translation: Maths is taught on Tuesdays.

sentences.pinyin: zuótiān xīngqīwǔ, suǒyǐ tā jiù xiūxi le.
sentences.translation: Yesterday was Friday, so he took a break.

sentences.hanzi: 昨天星期六。
sentences.pinyin: zuótiān xīngqīliù.
sentences.translation: Yesterday was Saturday.

sentences.translation: The shop is open from Monday to Saturday.

sentences.translation: We used to go to the movies on Saturday evening.

sentences.translation: Today is Thursday.

sentences.hanzi: 宇宙裡有多少個星系呀？

sentences.translation: He built an observatory to study the stars.

sentences.pinyin: tiānkōng qínglǎng, bùmǎn le xīngchén.
sentences.translation: The sky is clear and full of stars.

sentences.translation: I saw my reflection in the window.

sentences.translation: Spring has come.

sentences.pinyin: chūntiān shàngwèi láilín.
sentences.translation: It isn't spring yet.

sentences.hanzi: 春天是我最喜爱的季节。
sentences.pinyin: chūntiān shì wǒ zuìxǐ'ài de jìjié.
sentences.translation: Spring is my favorite season.

sentences.hanzi: 春天是适合种树的季节。
sentences.pinyin: chūntiān shì shìhé zhòngshù de jìjié.
sentences.translation: Spring is the season for planting trees.

sentences.translation: In Switzerland, spring comes in May.

sentences.translation: North China is cold in spring, so flowers don't bloom outdoors.

sentences.translation: I don't know when spring will come and when the flowers will bloom. It was still snowing this morning.

sentences.translation: Perhaps he would not celebrate Chinese New Year again.

sentences.pinyin: chūnjié, jí nónglìxīnnián.
sentences.translation: Spring Festival is also known as Chinese New Year.

sentences.translation: Celebrating Spring Festival is commonly referred to as 'passing the year'.

sentences.translation: April showers bring May flowers.

sentences.hanzi: 春雨带来了夏日百花。
sentences.pinyin: chūnyǔ dàilái le xiàrì bǎi huā.
sentences.translation: Spring rains bring summer flowers.

sentences.translation: Last night I was dead drunk and fell asleep without having a bath.

sentences.translation: Yesterday was what day of the week?

sentences.translation: It was cloudy yesterday.

sentences.translation: Tom and Mary want to make sure that doesn't happen to them.

sentences.translation: He is constantly complaining.

sentences.translation: At last, the truth was revealed to us.

sentences.translation: The President cannot disband the Parliament.

sentences.translation: A kilo of ketchup is equivalent to two kilos of tomatoes.

sentences.hanzi: 梅格买了一罐西红柿。
sentences.translation: Meg bought a can of tomatoes.

sentences.hanzi: 她在她花园里种西红柿。
sentences.translation: She grows tomatoes in her garden.

sentences.hanzi: 姐姐在市场买了一点茄子、土豆、西葫芦和大白菜。
sentences.pinyin: jiějie zài shìchǎng mǎi le yīdiǎn qiézi, tǔdòu, xīhúlu hé dàbáicài.
sentences.translation: Our sister bought some eggplants, potatoes, zucchinis and Chinese cabbage at the market.

sentences.hanzi: 西藍花是最健康的蔬菜之一。
sentences.pinyin: xīlánhuā shì zuì jiànkāng de shūcài zhīyī.
sentences.translation: Broccoli is one of the healthiest vegetables.

sentences.hanzi: 今天的西藍花不是很新鮮。
sentences.translation: The broccoli today isn't very fresh.

sentences.hanzi: 今天的西藍花做過頭了，不是很好吃。
sentences.translation: The broccoli is overcooked today — it's not very good.

sentences.hanzi: 西藏的好水就是世界的好水。
sentences.pinyin: xīzàng de hǎo shuǐ jiùshì shìjiè de hǎo shuǐ.
sentences.translation: Good water for Tibet is good water for the world.

sentences.hanzi: 西蘭花是最健康的蔬菜之一。
sentences.pinyin: xīlánhuā shì zuì jiànkāng de shūcài zhīyī.
sentences.translation: Broccoli is one of the healthiest vegetables.

sentences.hanzi: 身着西装，他脱颖而出。
sentences.pinyin: shēnzhuó xīzhuāng, tā tuōyǐng'érchū.
sentences.translation: Wearing a suit, he stood out.

sentences.hanzi: 我可以借你的灰色西装吗？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kěyǐ jiè nǐ de huīsè xīzhuāng ma?
sentences.translation: Could I borrow your gray suit?

sentences.hanzi: 这套西装合适吗？
sentences.pinyin: zhè tào xīzhuāng héshì ma?
sentences.translation: Does this suit fit?

sentences.hanzi: 领带和我的西装不配。
sentences.pinyin: lǐngdài hé wǒ de xīzhuāng bù pèi.
sentences.translation: The tie doesn't go with my suit.

sentences.hanzi: 这西装好像真的很贵。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xīzhuāng hǎoxiàng zhēnde hěn guì.
sentences.translation: This suit seems really expensive.

sentences.hanzi: 它们主要的看法其中也有“没有西装革履也可以很正经”。
sentences.pinyin: tāmen zhǔyào de kànfǎ qízhōng yě yǒu “méiyǒu xīzhuānggélǚ yě kěyǐ hěn zhèngjīng”.
sentences.translation: They also have ‘You can be serious without a suit’ as one of their key beliefs.

sentences.hanzi: 湯姆只在特殊場合穿西裝。
sentences.translation: Tom only wears a suit on special occasions.

sentences.hanzi: 這條領帶跟我的西裝不配。
sentences.translation: This tie doesn't go with my suit.

sentences.hanzi: 我給他的兒子做了一套新西裝。
sentences.translation: I made his son a new suit.

sentences.hanzi: 父親總是讓這位裁縫師為他做西裝。
sentences.translation: Father always has the tailor make his suits.

sentences.hanzi: 西西里是一座岛。
sentences.pinyin: xīxīlǐ shì yī zuò dǎo.
sentences.translation: Sicily is an island.

sentences.hanzi: 西西里的夏天炎热。
sentences.pinyin: xīxīlǐ de xiàtiān yánrè.
sentences.translation: Sicily is hot in summer.

sentences.hanzi: 你今天看西语了吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ jīntiān kàn xīyǔ le ma?
sentences.translation: Did you read any Spanish today?

sentences.hanzi: 他的西语水平還應該提高。
sentences.translation: His level of Spanish should still be improved.

sentences.hanzi: 太阳在西边下山。
sentences.pinyin: tàiyang zài xībiān xiàshān.
sentences.translation: The sun sets in the west.

sentences.hanzi: 太阳在西边落下。
sentences.pinyin: tàiyang zài xībiān luòxià.
sentences.translation: The sun sets in the west.

sentences.hanzi: 太阳从东边升起，西边落下。
sentences.pinyin: tàiyang cóng dōngbian shēngqǐ, xībiān luòxià.
sentences.translation: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

sentences.hanzi: 这个岛屿位于日本的西边。
sentences.pinyin: zhège dǎoyǔ wèiyú rìběn de xībiān.
sentences.translation: The island lies to the west of Japan.

sentences.hanzi: 贵族住在故宫的东边和西边。
sentences.pinyin: guìzú zhù zài gùgōng de dōngbian hé xībiān.
sentences.translation: Aristocrats lived to the east and west of the imperial palace.

sentences.hanzi: 塔有點向西邊傾斜。
sentences.pinyin: tǎ yǒudiǎn xiàng xībiān qīngxié.
sentences.translation: The tower leaned slightly to the west.

sentences.hanzi: Ziga说西里西亚语。
sentences.translation: Ziga speaks Silesian.

sentences.hanzi: 西里西亚省是波兰人口稠密度最大的地区。
sentences.translation: The Silesian Voivodeship is the most densely populated region of Poland.

sentences.hanzi: 他第一次來台北，就指名要去西門町逛街。
sentences.pinyin: tā dìyīcì láitái běi, jiù zhǐmíng yào qù xīméndīng guàngjiē.
sentences.translation: The first time he came to Taipei, he specifically wanted to go shopping in Ximending.

sentences.hanzi: 許多外國觀光客都把西門町列為台北必訪景點之一。
sentences.translation: Many foreign tourists consider Ximending one of the must-visit spots in Taipei.

sentences.hanzi: 我想去西雅图。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù xīyǎtú.
sentences.translation: I want to go to Seattle.

sentences.hanzi: 西面大楼的扩建在研究中。
sentences.pinyin: xīmiàn dàlóu de kuòjiàn zài yánjiū zhōng.
sentences.translation: The expansion of the building's west end is being studied.

sentences.hanzi: 要不要來點牛奶？
sentences.pinyin: yàobù yào lái diǎn niúnǎi?
sentences.translation: How about some milk?

sentences.hanzi: 要不一起到车站去？
sentences.pinyin: yàobù yīqǐ dào chēzhàn qù?
sentences.translation: Do you want to go to the station with me?

sentences.hanzi: 他在纠结要不要买这本书
sentences.pinyin: tā zài jiūjié yàobù yào mǎi zhè běn shū
sentences.translation: He is contemplating whether or not to buy the book.

sentences.hanzi: 要不要一起去圖書館自習？
sentences.pinyin: yàobù yào yīqǐ qù túshūguǎn zìxí?
sentences.translation: How about studying together in the library?

sentences.hanzi: 今天我休假，要不要一起玩游戏？
sentences.pinyin: jīntiān wǒ xiūjià, yàobù yào yīqǐ wán yóuxì?
sentences.translation: Since I have today off, shall we play a game?

sentences.hanzi: 要不是被绊了一下，我原本能赢的。
sentences.pinyin: yàobushì bèi bàn le yīxià, wǒ yuánběn néng yíng de.
sentences.translation: I would've won if I hadn't tripped.

sentences.hanzi: 要不是当初有内战，他们现在应该挺富裕了。
sentences.pinyin: yàobushì dāngchū yǒu nèizhàn, tāmen xiànzài yīnggāi tǐng fùyù le.
sentences.translation: If it had not been for civil war, they would be wealthy now.

sentences.hanzi: 要不是他这么磨磨蹭蹭，现在早做完了。
sentences.pinyin: yàobushì tā zhème mómócèngcèng, xiànzài zǎo zuòwán le.
sentences.translation: If he hadn't wasted time, he'd be finished by now.

sentences.hanzi: 我該走了，要不然我會遲到的。
sentences.translation: I have to go, otherwise I'll arrive late.

sentences.hanzi: 別把菸頭往地上扔，要不然蟑螂會得癌症的。
sentences.translation: Don't throw cigarette butts on the ground. Cockroaches might get cancer.

sentences.hanzi: 今天天气很冷，您多穿衣服吧，要不然会感冒的。
sentences.translation: It's really cold today. You should dress warmer or you might catch a cold.

sentences.hanzi: 要么你去，要么我去。
sentences.pinyin: yàome nǐ qù, yàome wǒqù.
sentences.translation: Either you go, or I go.

sentences.hanzi: 咱们要么说汉语，要么就别说话。
sentences.pinyin: zánmen yàome shuō hànyǔ, yàome jiù biéshuō huà.
sentences.translation: Let’s either speak Chinese, or not speak at all.

sentences.hanzi: 我要么去看电影，要么和朋友聊天。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yàome qù kàn diànyǐng, yàome hé péngyou liáotiān.
sentences.translation: I am either going to watch a movie, or chat with my friends.

sentences.hanzi: 我们必须学会像兄弟一样共同生活，要么就像傻子一样同归于尽。

sentences.translation: We must learn to live together as brothers, or we will perish together as fools.

sentences.hanzi: 我每天要么骑自行车，要么坐公车上班。
sentences.translation: Every day I either ride a bike or get the bus to work.

sentences.hanzi: 湯姆每天吃飯要嘛配魚，要嘛配雞胸肉。
sentences.pinyin: tāngmǔ měitiān chīfàn yàoma pèi yú, yàoma pèi jīxiōngròu.
sentences.translation: Tom eats rice every day either with fish or with chicken breast.

sentences.hanzi: 我不跟你要好了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù gēn nǐ yàohǎo le.
sentences.translation: I'm going to stop trying to be friendly with you.

sentences.hanzi: 正式工比临时工要好。
sentences.translation: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.

sentences.hanzi: 她今天比昨天要好很多。
sentences.translation: She is far better today than yesterday.

sentences.hanzi: 我母亲的法语比我父亲的英语要好，所以他们通常用法语交流。
sentences.translation: My mother speaks French better than my father speaks English, so they usually speak to each other in French.

sentences.hanzi: 你要好好記住他的話。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yàohǎo hǎojì zhù tā dehuà.
sentences.translation: Bear in mind what he said.

sentences.hanzi: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。
sentences.pinyin: tā de pínglùn jiǎnjié qiě jīzhòng yàohài.
sentences.translation: His comment was concise and to the point.

sentences.hanzi: 我不知道他有没有超能力，但是我猜他可能比一般人要强吧。
sentences.translation: I don't know if he has any special powers or not, but he's probably stronger than a normal human.

sentences.hanzi: 壞了，她要得分了。
sentences.translation: Damn, she's going to score.

sentences.hanzi: 我要得到爸爸媽媽的批准，才能和你一起去參加舞會。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yàodé dào bàba māma de pīzhǔn, cáinéng hé nǐ yīqǐ qù cānjiā wǔhuì.
sentences.translation: I'll have to get my parent's permission to go to the dance with you.

sentences.hanzi: 要是我说“不”呢？
sentences.pinyin: yàoshi wǒ shuō “bù” ne?
sentences.translation: And what if I say "no"?

sentences.hanzi: 我要是个独子就好了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yàoshi gè dúzǐ jiù hǎo le.
sentences.translation: I wish I were an only child.

sentences.hanzi: 你要是没出生就好了。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yàoshi méi chūshēng jiù hǎo le.
sentences.translation: It would have been better if you'd never been born.

sentences.hanzi: 要是我是你，我就会去。
sentences.pinyin: yàoshi wǒ shì nǐ, wǒ jiù huì qù.
sentences.translation: I would go if I were you.

sentences.hanzi: 你要是願意就留在這裡。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yàoshi yuànyì jiù liú zài zhèlǐ.
sentences.translation: You can stay here if you like.

sentences.hanzi: 一定要有蘋果。
sentences.pinyin: yīdìng yàoyǒu píngguǒ.
sentences.translation: Apples are necessary.

sentences.hanzi: 神说：“要有光。”
sentences.pinyin: shén shuō: “yàoyǒu guāng.”
sentences.translation: God said, "Let there be light!"

sentences.hanzi: 尤其是要有耐心。
sentences.pinyin: yóuqíshì yàoyǒu nàixīn.
sentences.translation: Above all, be patient.

sentences.hanzi: 一定要有人照顧病人。
sentences.pinyin: yīdìng yàoyǒu rén zhàogu bìngrén.
sentences.translation: Somebody must care for the patient.

sentences.hanzi: 开口要有礼貌，不讲下流话。
sentences.pinyin: kāikǒu yàoyǒu lǐmào, bù jiǎng xiàliú huà.
sentences.translation: One must be respectful when speaking, and not say obscene things.

sentences.hanzi: 誰要死了？
sentences.pinyin: shéi yàosǐ le?
sentences.translation: Who's dying?

sentences.hanzi: 我們早晚要死。
sentences.pinyin: wǒmen zǎowǎn yàosǐ.
sentences.translation: We will die sooner or later.

sentences.hanzi: 我明天要死了，所以后天没空。
sentences.translation: I'm going to die tomorrow, and so I won't be free the day after.

sentences.hanzi: 人都是要死的。
sentences.pinyin: rén dōu shì yàosǐ de.
sentences.translation: Everyone dies.

sentences.hanzi: 每个人都是注定要死的。
sentences.pinyin: měigerén dōu shì zhùdìng yàosǐ de.
sentences.translation: Everyone is doomed to die.

sentences.hanzi: 他的要求如下。

sentences.translation: His request is as follows.

sentences.hanzi: 他们要求加薪。
sentences.pinyin: tāmen yāoqiú jiāxīn.
sentences.translation: They asked for an increase of salary.

sentences.hanzi: 他要求我們安靜。
sentences.pinyin: tā yāoqiú wǒmen ānjìng.
sentences.translation: He asked that we be silent.

sentences.pinyin: tā yāoqiú wǒ mǎshàng fùqián.

sentences.pinyin: tā yāoqiú yuēhàn qù nàli.
sentences.translation: He demanded that John should go there.

sentences.hanzi: 我们必须找到要点。

sentences.translation: We've got to find the key.

sentences.pinyin: nǐ yàodiǎn cài ma?
sentences.translation: Would you like to order?

sentences.hanzi: 服务生，我要点菜。
sentences.pinyin: fúwùshēng, wǒ yàodiǎn cài.
sentences.translation: Waiter, I'd like to order.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ yàokàn yīxià zhège.
sentences.translation: I want to have a look at this one.

sentences.hanzi: 我要看看我能做甚麼。
sentences.translation: I'm going to see what I can do.

sentences.hanzi: 我倒要看看你能撐多久。
sentences.translation: I wonder how long you'll last.

sentences.hanzi: 你要看一部法国片，是吗？
sentences.translation: You want to watch a French film, is that right?

sentences.hanzi: 要看东京的景物只花几天时间是很难的。
sentences.translation: It is hard to see the sights of Tokyo in a few days.

sentences.hanzi: 自信是伟大事业的第一要素。
sentences.pinyin: zìxìn shì wěidà shìyè de dìyī yàosù.
sentences.translation: Self-confidence is the principal element of any great endeavor.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，友情也是幸福的一个要素。
sentences.pinyin: suǒyǐ, yǒuqíng yě shì xìngfú de yīge yàosù.
sentences.translation: So friendship is also a requirement for happiness.

sentences.hanzi: 对我自己来说，幸福有些根本的要素。
sentences.pinyin: duì wǒ zìjǐ lái shuō, xìngfú yǒuxiē gēnběn de yàosù.
sentences.translation: In my opinion, happiness has a few fundamental requirements.

sentences.hanzi: 其它的要素来自你跟别人的关系和你平日的活动。
sentences.pinyin: qítā de yàosù láizì nǐ gēn biéren de guānxi hé nǐ píngrì de huódòng.
sentences.translation: Other requirements come from your relationships with other people and your daily activities.

sentences.hanzi: 声称钱不是幸福的一个要素是愚蠢的。
sentences.translation: Claiming that money is not a requirement for happiness is foolish.

sentences.hanzi: 你怎么这么要紧哪！
sentences.translation: Why are you in such a hurry!

sentences.hanzi: 這沒什麼要緊的。
sentences.translation: It's nothing serious.

sentences.hanzi: 他在公司里身兼要职。
sentences.pinyin: tā zài gōngsī lǐ shēnjiān yàozhí.
sentences.translation: He holds an important position in the company.

sentences.hanzi: 叫那些人後退，直升機要著陸了。
sentences.translation: Tell those people to back off so that the helicopter can land.

sentences.hanzi: 我知道你要說不。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhīdào nǐ yàoshuō bù.
sentences.translation: I know you're going to say no.

sentences.hanzi: 我知道要說什麼。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhīdào yàoshuō shénme.
sentences.translation: I know what to say.

sentences.hanzi: 我不太確定要說什麼。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù tài quèdìng yàoshuō shénme.
sentences.translation: I wasn't quite sure what to say.

sentences.hanzi: 她為甚麼要說謊？
sentences.translation: Why would she lie?

sentences.hanzi: 我要說的就這些了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yàoshuō de jiù zhèxiē le.
sentences.translation: That's all I need to say.

sentences.hanzi: 还是要说谢谢的。
sentences.pinyin: háishi yàoshuō xièxie de.
sentences.translation: Thank you just the same.

sentences.hanzi: 这正是我要说的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhèngshì wǒ yàoshuō de.
sentences.translation: This is exactly what I want to talk about.

sentences.hanzi: 除非你有什么值得说的话要说，否则就别吭声。
sentences.translation: Don't speak unless you have something worth saying.

sentences.hanzi: 要说，就要说得有力量，使对方失去反驳的能力。
sentences.translation: If you're going to say it, you have to say it with force, and take away your opponent's ability to retaliate.

sentences.hanzi: 你有什么事要说吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yǒu shénmeshì yàoshuō ma?
sentences.translation: Do you have something to say?

sentences.hanzi: 一個外國人找到我，管我要錢。
sentences.pinyin: yīge wàiguórén zhǎodào wǒ, guǎn wǒ yàoqián.
sentences.translation: A foreigner came up to me and asked me for money.

sentences.hanzi: 他總是要錢。
sentences.pinyin: tā zǒngshì yàoqián.
sentences.translation: He is always asking for money.

sentences.hanzi: 弟弟問我要錢。
sentences.pinyin: dìdi wèn wǒ yàoqián.
sentences.translation: My little brother asked me for money.

sentences.hanzi: 不要問我要錢。
sentences.pinyin: bùyào wèn wǒ yàoqián.
sentences.translation: Don't ask me for money.

sentences.hanzi: 他要钱。
sentences.pinyin: tā yàoqián.
sentences.translation: He wants the money.

sentences.hanzi: 你想再要點茶嗎？
sentences.translation: Do you want some more tea?

sentences.hanzi: 覆水难收。
sentences.pinyin: fùshuǐnánshōu.
sentences.translation: It's no use crying over spilt milk.

sentences.hanzi: 覆水難收。
sentences.pinyin: fùshuǐnánshōu.
sentences.translation: What is done cannot be undone.

sentences.hanzi: 覆盆子很貴。
sentences.pinyin: fùpénzǐ hěn guì.
sentences.translation: Raspberries are very expensive.

sentences.hanzi: 我在吃一颗覆盆子。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài chī yī kē fùpénzǐ.
sentences.translation: I'm eating a raspberry.

sentences.hanzi: 這是覆盆子的顏色。
sentences.translation: This is the colour of raspberries.

sentences.hanzi: 桌子被灰尘覆盖。
sentences.pinyin: zhuōzi bèi huīchén fùgài.
sentences.translation: The table was covered with dust.

sentences.hanzi: 墙被常青藤覆盖了一部分。
sentences.pinyin: qiáng bèi chángqīngténg fùgài le yībùfen.
